fixed.problem: منظوری is the glossary term for approvals (pending tool approvals, relay.asks.pending.kind_approval «منظوری درکار»); an amber «منظوری کا انتظار» on a tool row reads as a pending tool approval the operator must act on. The concept is the owner accepting the DM/invitation, which Team Bridge already renders as قبول (ui.teamBridge.invitations.accept «قبول کریں»).
Latin 'hub' inside Urdu prose; every other ur UI string writes the generic noun as ہب (ui.agents.publication.*, ui.common.errors.public_hub_*). It is not a product name or identifier.

The Team Bridge UI names a DM براہ راست پیغام (ui.teamBridge.kind.dm, section.directs); the headline has room for the full form. Bare fallbacks (fallback.dm «ایک ڈی ایم») and the inbox_only advice keep ڈی ایم.

The ur catalogues' settled word for a refusal is مسترد (hub/server/API-key refusals across ui.agents, ui.settings, ui.mesh); رد کر دیا گیا is also 13 cells for a one-word status slot (sidecar: 'One word') vs 5.
